string.name: channel_passes_name
string.translation_description: Name of the notification channel for alerts shortly before a satellite passes overhead.

string.name: channel_passes_description
string.translation_description: Description of the satellite-pass notification channel.

resources.string: Une seule alerte peu avant le meilleur passage visible de la nuit

string.name: notif_pass_title
string.translation_description: Title of the notification sent shortly before a satellite passes overhead. %1$s is the satellite name.

string.name: notif_pass_text
string.translation_description: Body of the satellite pass notification, telling the user when to go outside. %1$s is a time.

resources.string: Visible à partir d\'environ %1$s — sortez et laissez vos yeux s\'adapter

string.name: channel_eclipses_name
string.translation_description: Name of the notification channel for alerts before a lunar eclipse starts.

string.name: channel_eclipses_description
string.translation_description: Description of the lunar-eclipse notification channel.

resources.string: Une seule alerte avant le début d\'une éclipse lunaire

string.name: notif_eclipse_title
string.translation_description: Title of the notification sent before a lunar eclipse starts. %1$s is a localized eclipse type like \'Total lunar eclipse\'.

string.name: notif_eclipse_text
string.translation_description: Body of the lunar eclipse notification, telling the user when it begins. %1$s is a time.

resources.string: Commence vers %1$s — ça vaut le coup de sortir

string.name: satellite_name_iss
string.translation_description: Display name for the International Space Station.

string.name: satellite_description
string.translation_description: Short description shown on the info card for an artificial satellite.

resources.string: Un satellite artificiel en orbite terrestre basse, illuminé par le soleil sur un ciel sombre. Il traverse d\'un horizon à l\'autre en quelques minutes, se déplaçant de manière régulière et sans clignoter.

string.name: tonight_satellite_pass
string.translation_description: Tonight-widget row announcing a visible satellite pass. %1$s is the satellite name, %2$s is a time of day.

string.name: tonight_trailing_pass
string.translation_description: Small trailing note on a satellite pass row. %1$s is a compass direction, %2$d is an angle in degrees, %3$.1f is a brightness magnitude.

string.name: no_sensor_warning
string.translation_description: Warning shown when the device lacks the motion sensors needed to point the map at the sky automatically.

resources.string: Cet appareil n\'a pas de boussole ni de capteurs de mouvement, donc Sky Map ne peut pas suivre votre orientation. Faites glisser la carte manuellement à la place.

string.name: hud_alignment_reset_message
string.translation_description: Snackbar confirming the sensor-alignment correction was cleared; shown with an Undo action.

string.name: ar_auto_mode_snackbar
string.translation_description: Snackbar shown when turning on through-camera mode switched the map from manual dragging back to automatic sensor pointing.

resources.string: Mode auto activé pour la vue caméra

string.name: ar_permission_denied
string.translation_description: Snackbar shown when the user declined the camera permission that through-camera mode needs.

resources.string: Le mode caméra nécessite l\'autorisation d\'utiliser la caméra

string.name: ar_alignment_adjusted_message
string.translation_description: Snackbar shown after the user drags the star map to align it with the camera image; shown with an Undo action that reverts the whole drag.

string.name: share_chooser_title
string.translation_description: Title of the system share sheet when sharing a captured sky image.

string.name: share_invitation
string.translation_description: Short invitation stamped on the footer of shared sky images, above the store link.

resources.string: Voyez ce que vous regardez — obtenez Sky Map gratuitement

string.name: share_text
string.translation_description: Text accompanying a shared sky image in apps that accept both an image and text. %1$s is the app-store link.

resources.string: Voyez ce que vous regardez — obtenez Sky Map gratuitement : %1$s

string.name: share_layout_overlay
string.translation_description: Caption of the share-layout choice that draws the star map over the camera photo, as seen on screen.

string.name: share_layout_side_by_side
string.translation_description: Caption of the share-layout choice that puts the camera photo and the star map next to each other.

string.name: share_failed_message
string.translation_description: Snackbar shown when capturing the sky image for sharing failed.

resources.string: Impossible de capturer le ciel — réessayez

string.name: snackbar_action_undo
string.translation_description: Snackbar action button that reverses the change the snackbar reports, e.g. re-enabling horizon auto-leveling

string.name: label_size_hint_message
string.translation_description: Snackbar shown once, the first time the user zooms in a long way. Explains that the text labels naming stars and other objects stay the same size however far you zoom, and that their size is changed in the app\'s Settings screen instead. Shown with an action button that opens Settings.

resources.string: La taille des étiquettes ne change pas avec le zoom — définissez-la dans les paramètres

string.name: label_size_hint_action
string.translation_description: Action button on the label size snackbar; opens the app\'s Settings screen, where the user can change how large the sky labels are

string.name: auto_level_on_toast
string.translation_description: Brief confirmation shown when a double tap turns horizon auto-leveling on in manual mode

string.name: auto_level_off_toast
string.translation_description: Brief confirmation shown when a double tap turns horizon auto-leveling off in manual mode

string.name: diagnostics_satellite_data

string.name: diagnostics_satellite_data_none
string.translation_description: Row value in the diagnostics screen when no satellite orbital data has been downloaded yet

string.translation_description: Row value in the diagnostics screen showing how many satellites are cached and how many days old the data is. %1$d is a count, %2$.1f is a number of days

string.name: diagnostics_satellite_last_fetch
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for the result of the most recent attempt to download satellite orbital data

string.name: diagnostics_satellite_never_fetched
string.translation_description: Row value in the diagnostics screen when satellite orbital data has never been downloaded

string.name: diagnostics_satellite_circuit_open
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for when satellite downloads are paused after repeated server errors

string.name: diagnostics_satellite_circuit_open_format
string.translation_description: Row value in the diagnostics screen showing when paused satellite downloads will resume and how many failures caused the pause. %1$s is a date and time, %2$d is a count

string.name: whats_new_version_heading
string.translation_description: Heading above the list of new features. %1$s is the app version name

string.name: widgets_sheet_title
string.translation_description: Title of the sheet listing the home-screen widgets the app offers

string.name: widgets_sheet_subtitle
string.translation_description: Subtitle of the widgets sheet, explaining what the listed widgets are for

resources.string: Gardez le ciel de ce soir sur votre écran d\'accueil. Choisissez-en un à ajouter.

string.name: moon_widget_label
string.translation_description: Name of the moon-phase home-screen widget, shown in the launcher\'s widget picker

string.name: moon_widget_description
string.translation_description: Description of the moon-phase widget, shown under its preview in the launcher\'s widget picker

resources.string: La phase de la Lune, son illumination et ses heures de lever et de coucher, mis à jour quotidiennement.

string.translation_description: Widget line showing how much of the Moon\'s disc is lit; %1$d is a percentage number

string.translation_description: Widget fragment showing today\'s moonset time; %1$s is a clock time like 03:12

string.translation_description: Compact suffix appended after a widget rise/set time that falls on a later day than today, so a reader doesn\'t mistake it for today\'s crossing; %1$d is the number of days ahead (almost always 1). Keep it short — the widget is very narrow. Note the leading space.

string.name: moon_phase_new

string.name: moon_phase_waxing_crescent
string.translation_description: Name of the lunar phase between new moon and first quarter

string.name: moon_phase_first_quarter
string.translation_description: Name of the lunar phase when half the disc is lit and growing

string.name: moon_phase_waxing_gibbous
string.translation_description: Name of the lunar phase between first quarter and full moon

string.name: moon_phase_full
string.translation_description: Name of the lunar phase when the disc is fully lit

string.name: moon_phase_waning_gibbous
string.translation_description: Name of the lunar phase between full moon and last quarter

string.name: moon_phase_last_quarter
string.translation_description: Name of the lunar phase when half the disc is lit and shrinking

string.name: moon_phase_waning_crescent
string.translation_description: Name of the lunar phase between last quarter and new moon

string.name: moon_widget_promo_title
string.translation_description: Title of the row on the Moon\'s info card offering to add the moon-phase widget to the home screen

resources.string: Gardez la Lune sur votre écran d\'accueil

string.name: moon_widget_promo_subtitle
string.translation_description: Subtitle of the row offering the moon-phase widget, summarizing what the widget shows

resources.string: Phase, illumination et heures de lever, mis à jour quotidiennement

string.name: moon_widget_promo_add
string.translation_description: Button that adds the moon-phase widget to the home screen via the system dialog

string.name: moon_widget_pin_unsupported_title
string.translation_description: Title of the fallback dialog when the launcher cannot add widgets directly

resources.string: Ajoutez le widget depuis votre écran d\'accueil

string.translation_description: Body of the fallback dialog explaining how to add the widget manually

resources.string: Votre lanceur ne prend pas en charge l\'ajout de widgets depuis une application. Appuyez longuement sur votre écran d\'accueil, choisissez Widgets, puis trouvez Sky Map.

string.translation_description: Confirmation button of the manual widget-adding instructions dialog

string.name: moon_widget_preview_illumination
string.translation_description: Representative illumination line shown in the widget picker\'s preview of the moon-phase widget

string.translation_description: Small header label on the tonight widget; %1$s is a short date like \'Wed 30 Jul\'

string.translation_description: Header line on the tonight widget; %1$s is the sunset time, %2$s the time the sky becomes fully dark

string.name: tonight_widget_sunset_only
string.translation_description: Header fragment when only the sunset time is known; %1$s is the sunset time

string.translation_description: Representative highlight row shown in the widget picker\'s preview of the tonight widget

string.translation_description: Representative event name shown in the widget picker\'s preview of the countdown widget

string.translation_description: Name of the meteor-shower notification channel, shown in the system\'s notification settings

string.translation_description: Description of the meteor-shower notification channel in the system\'s notification settings

resources.string: Environ une douzaine par an, le soir du pic

string.name: channel_digest_name
string.translation_description: Name of the tonight-digest notification channel, shown in the system\'s notification settings

resources.string: Résumé du ciel de ce soir

string.translation_description: Description of the tonight-digest notification channel in the system\'s notification settings
